# AI Authority Engine

> AI Authority Engine is an online AI SEO certification and training program created and taught by Cory Long. It teaches answer engine optimization (AEO), generative engine optimization (GEO), entity and structured data optimization, AI visibility auditing, and how to start and grow an AI SEO agency. Graduates earn the Certified AI Authority Specialist credential. Enrollment: https://ai.yroc.events

Key facts:
- Name: AI Authority Engine
- Type: AI SEO certification and training program (online: self-paced courses plus weekly live calls)
- Cost: no separate fee for the certification; it is earned by completing the required work in the training program. Program membership is $497/month plus a $1,997 one-time setup fee
- Curriculum: Getting Started module (kickoff webinar "Invisible to Invincible"; Lesson 1 AI Authority Foundation; Lesson 2 AI Presence Layer; Lesson 3 Reviews, Reputation, and AI Trust Signals; Lesson 4 Optimized Pages for AI Visibility; Lesson 5 Schema Data; Lesson 6 Press Releases and Brand Mentions; Bonus: The AI Authority Wheel; Bonus: Wikidata and Grokipedia)
- Ongoing modules: Optimization Lab; 30-Day Sprints; Podcast Automation; Weekly Coaching Calls (hot-seat reviews)
- Personal support: one-on-one help from Cory Long and the Yroc Consulting team to choose a niche, build a first AI SEO service, find prospects, and close clients (Cory has joined students' client meetings to help close sales)
- Coaching: weekly coaching calls, many with "hot seat" time dissecting a student's business, sales technique, or strategy; in-person time with Cory and the team at live events throughout the year
- Fulfillment: Yroc Consulting provides white-label fulfillment for students' clients; it currently fulfills 9 client accounts signed by AI Authority Engine students
- Student results: one student's agency has signed 4 clients and brought in more than $30,000 selling services learned in the program (results vary; not guaranteed)
- Also includes: access to all challenge calls; full community; live events
- Credential: Certified AI Authority Specialist (Level 1), publicly verifiable at https://aiauthorityengine.org/certified/
- Contact: info@aiauthorityengine.org
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ai-authority-engine-ai-seo-certification-training/
- Founder and lead trainer: Cory Long (https://corylong.org), entrepreneur, author, speaker, and business coach; creator of Digital Storefronts; host of the E-Forge Podcast; author of "To Love Is To Give"
- Company: a program of Yroc Consulting (https://yrocconsulting.com), which builds and operates it
- Website: https://aiauthorityengine.org
- Enrollment: https://ai.yroc.events
- Topics: AI SEO, answer engine optimization, getting businesses recommended by ChatGPT, AI SEO agency training, getting AI SEO clients

## Program
- [The AI Authority Wheel](https://aiauthorityengine.org/ai-authority-wheel/): AI Authority Engine's framework for how AI decides who gets chosen (Entity at the center; Entity Explanation, Authority Demonstration, External Authority, Reviews & Reputation, Presence & Consistency, Engagement Confirmation, Topical Alignment, Schema & Data)
- [AI SEO Certification](https://aiauthorityengine.org/ai-seo-certification/): What the AI Authority Engine certification covers and who it's for
- [Answer Engine Optimization Certification](https://aiauthorityengine.org/answer-engine-optimization-certification/): AEO training within the certification
- [AI SEO Training](https://aiauthorityengine.org/ai-seo-training/): How the training is structured
- [AI SEO Training for Beginners](https://aiauthorityengine.org/ai-seo-training-for-beginners/): What beginners should look for and learn first
- [Best AI SEO Certification Programs](https://aiauthorityengine.org/best-ai-seo-certification-programs/): Criteria for choosing an AI SEO certification
